headline: Forward Thinking Engineer
summary: Forward Thinking Engineer. Focus: shadowing employees to learn how they work, building each person a custom AI agent that fits their day, and teaching them to use it well, then scaling across the company. Independent, AI-assisted developer of local workflow tools, desktop interfaces and source-grounded review workflows. Background includes service and hands-on work.

experience.title: Independent Project Development - AI-Assisted Software & Evaluation
experience.intro: Direct AI-assisted implementation, debugging, testing and review of local tools, API integrations and documented human next steps.

projects.name: Ergon - Personalized Employee Assistant & Remote Support
bullets: Built a Windows employee-assistant installer with Outis taskbar management, reviewed onboarding and a Linux support service. Preserves employee data across upgrades.
Implemented device-scoped support, durable repair tracking, approved phone workflows and shared AI budgets, with Haiku defaults and bounded expert consultation.
projects.short: Built a Windows employee-assistant installer with reviewed onboarding, Outis support management, approved phone workflows and shared AI budgets.

projects.name: Industry AI Suite - Source-Grounded Review Tools
projects.stack: Python, HTTP APIs, Local LLMs, HTML/CSS/JavaScript
bullets: Built ten local review tools for finance, research, security and operations, with source receipts and explicit human review. Added durable history, review decisions, export and deletion.
Integrated optional loopback model drafting from minimized findings, with exact citation checks and explicit failure handling.
projects.short: Built ten source-grounded review tools with cited local model drafts, durable history and review, export and deletion flows.

projects.name: dotz - Multi-Agent Coding Dashboard
bullets: Developed a Rust and Tauri agent desktop with model selection, supervised tools and platform-specific process cleanup.
Made local model failures explicit and added safe cleanup retries. Core tests, lint and dependency checks pass on Windows, macOS and Linux.
projects.short: Developed a Rust and Tauri agent desktop with explicit local routing and supervised tools; core checks pass on Windows, macOS and Linux.

projects.name: Sophos - Coding-Agent Desktop
bullets: Connected employee-selected agent profiles to real daemon sessions and local model catalogs, with durable session transcripts and restart recovery.
Reconciled parallel source histories while preserving lifecycle, security and build controls; verified the application and daemon with regression tests.
projects.short: Connected agent profiles and local model catalogs to a coding-agent desktop, with durable sessions and tested restart recovery.

projects.name: Asmodeus - Research & Paper Replay
bullets: Built a research and paper replay system with verified historical data, chronological evaluation, persisted cursors, fees and duplicate-fill prevention.
Added a keyless loopback model route with redirect and proxy guards, chronological train/validation/test slices and reviewable refutation records.
projects.short: Built a research and paper replay system with historical-data provenance, chronological evaluation and restart-safe simulated fills.
